title: Arabic Safety Alignment as Selective Refusal: An Empirical Study of SFT, DPO, and Guard Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2608.29378v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Arabic large language models must refuse harmful prompts without over-refusing benign or sensitive prompts, yet a single refusal rate hides this trade-off. We evaluate it using benign refusal B and harmful-prompt refusal H, where H measures refusal rather than harmful compliance. Across five Arabic-capable models and 130 runs on the full human-written AraSafe set, refusal-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses toward blanket refusal, whereas selected mixed-SFT configurations reach H = 90% to 93% at B = 14% to 23%; four selected configurations exceed the H = 90% target in all three runs, while Fanar does so in two of three. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and inference guards change B and H differently across models rather than acting as uniform upgrades. translated_title: 阿拉伯语安全对齐作为选择性拒绝：SFT、DPO 与护栏校准的实证研究
translated_abstract: 阿拉伯语大语言模型必须拒绝有害提示，同时不过度拒绝良性或敏感提示，然而单一的拒绝率指标掩盖了这一权衡。我们采用良性拒绝率 B 和有害提示拒绝率 H 来评估该权衡，其中 H 衡量的是拒绝行为而非对有害请求的顺从。在五个支持阿拉伯语的模型上，基于完整人工撰写的 AraSafe 数据集进行的 130 次运行中，仅拒绝式监督微调（SFT）会坍缩为全面拒绝，而精选的混合 SFT 配置能够在 B = 14% 至 23% 的条件下达到 H = 90% 至 93%；四个精选配置在全部三次运行中均超过 H = 90% 的目标，而 Fanar 在三次运行中有两次达标。直接偏好优化（DPO）和推理时护栏对不同模型的 B 和 H 的影响各不相同，而非作为统一的改进手段。在一项盲评的 300 条回复审计中，标注者二元拒绝判断的一致性为 89.0%（kappa = 0.78）；Qwen3Guard 和 Aya Expanse 32B 分别达到 88.7% 和 91.0% 的准确率，而
tldr: 该研究提出用良性拒绝率 B 和有害提示拒绝率 H 双指标评估阿拉伯语大模型安全对齐，发现仅拒绝式 SFT 会坍缩为全面拒绝，而精选混合 SFT 配置能在低良性拒绝率下实现 90% 以上的有害提示拒绝，且 DPO 与推理护栏的效果因模型而异、并非统一提升。
en_tdlr: This empirical study introduces a dual-metric evaluation (benign refusal B vs. harmful-prompt refusal H) for Arabic LLM safety alignment, showing that refusal-only SFT collapses into blanket refusal while selected mixed-SFT configurations achieve over 90% harmful-prompt refusal at low benign refusal rates, and that DPO and inference guards affect models inconsistently rather than serving as uniform upgrades.
